summary: AIMind_Ai demonstrates a QWOP-style 3D browser game created with Claude Opus 5.5 where players control four teats using Q, W, O, and P keys to make a legless cow sprint to a 100-meter finish line.
summaryEn: Interactive browser game of a cow running on its teats built with Claude Opus 5.5

post.originalText:
The cow that runs on her udder is now a browser game.

Claude Opus 5.5 built it. You control every teat yourself: Q, W, O, P. The finish is at 100 m.

Nobody is finishing this. I tried 20 times and didn't even make it halfway.

Link in the replies. Drop your distance below. if you reach 100, post proof, because I won't believe you.

sourceMaterials.text: @shuizhuyu 20m is decent. Race conditions stay put, this one doesn’t. A few already finished the whole thing. Link’s in the replies.
